description: Portal de la bicicleta (spainbybike.es) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica (CNIG). Cycladic stages included in the Spanish cycling routes portal spainbybike.es. It also includes mountain passes and mountain biking areas. Coverage: Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica (CNIG). The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle Portal (spainbybike.es)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica (CNIG). Its keywords include Bicicleta, BTT, Etapa, Rutas. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
